title: WindowsAzure.Storage is deprecated on NuGet
summary: Microsoft marked every version of WindowsAzure.Storage as deprecated (reason: Legacy) because the package has been obsolete since 2023-03-31 and is no longer maintained or monitored. The deprecation names Azure.Storage.Common as the replacement.
replacement: Azure.Storage.Blobs, Azure.Storage.Queues, Azure.Storage.Files.Shares, or Azure.Data.Tables, with Azure.Storage.Common

constraints: Keep the data format and the blob, queue, and table names the same; only the client library changes.

steps.title: Move to the Azure.Storage.* packages
steps.instructions: Replace WindowsAzure.Storage with the package for each service in use (Azure.Storage.Blobs, Azure.Storage.Queues, Azure.Storage.Files.Shares, or Azure.Data.Tables) and update CloudStorageAccount and CloudBlobClient code to the new client types.

verification.purpose: Build and test after the client library change.
